title: Doc Document Shape
reader: An engineer who will write a doc.json file by hand for a test fixture
prompt: Write a short reference page for the shape of a doc.json document. Show the shape of a document and of one block, with the type of each field and which fields are optional. Explain in 2 or 3 sentences how the block map and the children lists make the tree.

title: Docs Daemon State
reader: An engineer who will debug why an agent cannot reach the docs daemon
prompt: Write a short reference page for the daemon.json state file that the docs MCP daemon writes. Show the shape of the file with the type of each field, say where the file lives and who reads it, and give one example.
